description: Lockheed Martin ODIN Prognostics & Health Management (PHM) and Portable Maintenance Aid (PMA) post-sortie Health Reporting Codes (HRCs) and Built-In Test (BIT) fault telemetry events across RAF Marham (617 Sqn, 207 Sqn) and HMS Queen Elizabeth (809 NAS). Tracks continuous BIT, initiated BIT, prognostic threshold exceedances, Pilot-Reported-Only (Zero-BIT) anomalies, Can-Not-Duplicate (CND) chronic repeat rates, diagnostic isolation confidence, and linked Form 707A maintenance work orders.

fields.name: fault_event_id
fields.description: Primary Key (PK): Unique ODIN PHM / PMA Built-In Test fault event identifier (e.g., PHM-2026-99101).

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Cluster Key: UK Lightning Force aircraft serial number (e.g., ZM151, ZM154). Foreign key to airframe_component_telemetry.tail_number.

fields.name: aircraft_variant
fields.description: F-35 aircraft variant designation ('F-35B' STOVL for UK Lightning Force squadrons).

fields.name: squadron
fields.description: Assigned operational squadron ('617 Sqn (The Dambusters)', '809 NAS (The Immortals)', or '207 Sqn (OCU)').

fields.name: base_location
fields.description: Operating air station or carrier strike group location ('RAF Marham' or 'HMS Queen Elizabeth').

fields.name: sortie_id
fields.description: Foreign Key (FK -> squadron_sortie_schedule.sortie_id): Sortie identifier during or after which the fault was recorded; NULL for ground deck checks.

fields.name: wuc_code
fields.description: S1000D / JTD Work Unit Code identifying the faulted aircraft subsystem (e.g., '27-10', '53-30', '53-20', '34-40', '72-30').

fields.name: subsystem_name
fields.description: Human-readable F-35 subsystem nomenclature corresponding to wuc_code (e.g., 'Forward Fuselage Canopy Latch').

fields.name: hrc_code
fields.description: ODIN Health Reporting Code (HRC) or BIT fault code emitted by onboard vehicle management / avionics processors (e.g., 'HRC-2710-88A', 'HRC-5330-000-NONE').

fields.name: fault_severity
fields.description: Cluster Key: Operational severity classification: 'CRITICAL_GROUNDING', 'DEGRADED_PMC', 'ADVISORY_PHM', or 'NO_BIT_FAULT_LOGGED'.

fields.name: recurrence_count_30d
fields.description: Number of times this HRC / WUC fault signature has recurred on the same tail within the trailing 30-day operational window.

fields.name: cnd_flag
fields.description: Can-Not-Duplicate (CND) / intermittent repeat fault indicator (TRUE if previous ground BIT checks failed to reproduce the fault).

fields.name: diagnostic_confidence_pct
fields.description: Unit: percentage (%). ODIN PHM automated fault-tree isolation confidence score (0.0% for uninstrumented Zero-BIT mechanical faults up to 99.8%).

fields.name: linked_work_order_id
fields.description: Foreign Key (FK -> maintenance_work_orders.work_order_id): Associated ODIN / MOD Form 707A Job Control Number (e.g., 'WO-2026-88401'), or NULL if unactioned.

fields.name: fault_timestamp_utc
fields.description: Partition Key (DAY): UTC timestamp when the PHM/BIT event or post-sortie PMA download was recorded.
